description:
Add HIP implementations of the Rayleigh and Rician flat-fading channel stages so fading campaigns can keep noise generation on the device, as AWGN campaigns already do.

## Background

The GPU path has a ChaCha20 + Box-Muller AWGN kernel (`crates/gf2-sim/src/gpu/awgn.rs`). Rayleigh and Rician exist only as CPU stages, so a hybrid fading chain transfers symbols back to the host for the channel step.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: GPU Rayleigh and Rician stages exist with CPU fallbacks to the existing CPU stages.
- [hard] REQ-02: For a fixed seed the GPU stages consume the same ChaCha20 word positions as the CPU stages, and their outputs match the CPU stages within the tolerance used by the existing GPU AWGN byte-identity tests.
- [hard] REQ-03: The GPU stages emit the per-symbol channel gain alongside the received symbols, in the same form as the CPU fading stages.
title: GPU fading channel stages
